summary: The sh shell plugin is the POSIX /bin/sh shell, the most compatible choice for Unix systems.
questions: Which shell plugin should I use for Linux hosts?
What is the default shell plugin on Unix?

answer_card.title: POSIX sh shell plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.sh` is the POSIX `/bin/sh` shell plugin, the most compatible choice for Unix systems.
